# hivecontrol help fixtures

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `hivecontrol-2.5.2-workspace-help.txt` | REAL — captured verbatim from `hivecontrol workspace --help` on DevSwarm 2.5.2. |
| `hivecontrol-2.5.3-workspace-help.txt` | REAL — captured verbatim from `hivecontrol workspace --help` on DevSwarm 2.5.3 (`hivecontrol --version` = 2.5.3). |
| `hivecontrol-2.5.3-archive-help.txt` / `-delete-help.txt` | REAL — `hivecontrol workspace archive --help` / `delete --help` on 2.5.3. Both take an optional `[idOrBranch]` (default = the CURRENT workspace), have no `--yes` flag and never prompt. |
